links.note: Asks straight out whether the story could be factually true; 31678 'Can the story be true' is that exact discussion question. Its sibling 31677 covers the closing narratorial aside, not the truth of the tale.

The accepted option is (iv) 'How the camel got his hump' - i.e. the title event, which is the moment in 31675 when the repeated Humph swells into a hump. Not 31678 (that is question 1's truth-of-the-tale) and not 31671 (the work-shortfall moral is the rejected option (ii)).

The 'check your back before you answer' instruction and the active-or-idle self-placement are both written into 31679; 31673 is the horse's question of principle to the Djinn, not the learner's own audit.

The two-categories-of-workers wording is 31679's description verbatim (those who put off until tomorrow vs those who do today). 31680 is the separate dignity-of-work closing note, which this item does not ask about.
